2607.06111.title: LLM-Guided Measurement Credibility Correction for Trustworthy Industrial Process Inference
2607.06111.paper_summary: Industrial prediction and soft sensing depend on credible input measurements. In field deployment, a predictor may receive biased, delayed, stale, or derived measurements that still look plausible. Prediction can then fail before the forecasting backbone becomes the main limitation, because the input window no longer represents the real process. Sensor reconstruction, data reconciliation, and fault-tolerant soft sensing reduce this risk, but they often rely on numerical correlation, alarms, fault labels, or explicit process equations. These assumptions are not always available. A correlated variable can also be an unsafe reference when variables share instruments, derived formulas, soft-sensing chains, or control actions. The key issue is to decide before prediction which external measurements can credibly support the current measurement. To address this issue, this article proposes LLM-Guided Measurement Credibility Correction (MCC). MCC converts measurement meanings in process documents into measurement semantics usable by numerical models. It builds independent process references from semantically qualified external measurements and corrects local measurement conflicts before prediction. The predictor therefore receives a more credible input window. Across multiple complex industrial forecasting and soft-sensing tasks, +MCC achieves average relative MAE reductions of 30.7% on real-test protocols and 80.3% on controlled-corruption protocols. It adds only 0.5--2.0k online parameters, with the slowest +MCC inference time at 0.089 ms/step. These results show that measurement semantics can turn process documents into lightweight pre-inference credibility correction and improve prediction accuracy.
2607.06111.paper_summary_zh: 工業預測和軟感知依賴於可信的輸入測量。<lb/>在現場部署中，預測器可能會收到偏差、延遲、過時或衍生的測量，這些測量看起來仍然合理。<lb/>在預測骨幹成為主要限制之前，預測可能會失敗，因為輸入窗口不再代表真實過程。<lb/>傳感器重建、數據調和和容錯軟感知減少了這種風險，但它們通常依賴於數值相關性、警報、故障標籤或明確的過程方程。<lb/>這些假設並不總是可用的。<lb/>當變量共享儀器、衍生公式、軟感知鏈或控制行動時，相關變量也可能成為不安全的參考。<lb/>關鍵問題是在預測之前決定哪些外部測量可以可信地支持當前測量。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，本文提出了LLM引導的測量可信度修正（MCC）。<lb/>MCC將過程文件中的測量意義轉換為可供數值模型使用的測量語義。<lb/>它從語義合格的外部測量中構建獨立的過程參考，並在預測之前修正本地測量衝突。<lb/>因此，預測器接收到更可信的輸入窗口。<lb/>在多個複雜的工業預測和軟感知任務中，+MCC在實際測試協議上實現了平均相對MAE降低30.7%，在受控損壞協議上實現了80.3%的降低。<lb/>它僅增加了0.5--2.0k的在線參數，最慢的+MCC推理時間為0.089毫秒/步。<lb/>這些結果表明，測量語義可以將過程文件轉化為輕量級的預推理可信度修正，並提高預測準確性。
